findings.claim: Readiness is reported even when companion-listener initialization fails, violating the stated readiness contract.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criteria / What Changes requires: "Emit the stdout readiness record only after the HTTP application and companion listener are initialized successfully." The diff calls `let companion = bind_companion_listener(&config.server.host, primary_addr.port()).await;` where `bind_companion_listener` returns `Option<TcpListener>` and explicitly treats failure as non-fatal, then unconditionally sends readiness with `ready.send(primary_addr)` regardless of whether `companion` is `None`.
findings.suggested_fix: For sidecar startup, make companion binding failure a startup error before sending readiness, or adjust the acceptance/spec language to define the companion listener as optional and not part of the readiness success condition.
